map.轴径规格 10±0.05（USL=10.05、LSL=9.95），μ=10.0、: Shaft diameter spec 10±0.05 (USL=10.05, LSL=9.95), μ=10.0, σ=0.01: Cpk = min[(10.05-10.0)/(3×0.01), (10.0-9.95)/(3×0.01)] = min[0.05/0.03, 0.05/0.03] = min[1.667, 1.667] = 1.667, the mean is centered so it equals Cp. If tool wear shifts μ to 10.02: Cpk = min[(10.05-10.02)/0.03, (10.02-9.95)/0.03] = min[1.000, 2.333] = 1.000; even though dispersion is unchanged, the shift has dropped capability below 1.33.
map.Cpk 为什么取两者最小值？: Why does Cpk take the minimum of the two?
map.过程只能以『更受限的一侧』为准：若均值偏上，超出上限的风险更大；偏下则低于下限风: The process can only be judged by the 'more constrained side': if the mean is high, the risk of exceeding the upper limit is greater; if low, the risk of falling below the lower limit is greater. Taking min conservatively treats the worst side as the overall capability, avoiding being masked by the good-looking number on the other side.
map.Cpk 到多少才算合格？: How high must Cpk be to be considered acceptable?
map.没有统一铁律，取决于行业与客户：一般制造业 ≥1.33，汽车/医疗/航空常要求: There is no universal hard rule; it depends on the industry and customer: general manufacturing ≥1.33, automotive/medical/aerospace often require ≥1.67, critical safety parts higher. Below 1.0 is usually considered a non-conforming process that must be corrected before batch delivery.
